# Local QR encoder

`qrcode-generator.js` is the unmodified browser build from **qrcode-generator 1.4.4**, by Kazuhiko Arase, under the MIT license in `qrcode-generator.LICENSE`.

Source archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

SHA-256 of the vendored JavaScript: `18ae399f81182bc9de916e9c77b195df20cc58d6f2d55a62b085a299f1bf1780`.

The arcade serves this file locally. Profile Pass contents are encoded entirely in the browser and are never sent to a QR image service. `classroom-pass-qr.js` provides a high-contrast SVG with a four-module quiet zone and generic accessible text that does not repeat the secret.
